openfda.title: Drug shortages (drug/shortages endpoint), bulk download
openfda.notes: One record per affected product presentation, as listed in the FDA Drug Shortages Database and tracked by CDER. Grouped here by generic name: a shortage is current when any of its presentations has status Current. Start is the earliest initial posting date. openFDA data is public domain (CC0); FDA says results are unvalidated and should not be used for medical decisions.

comtrade.title: International trade statistics: HS 30 (pharmaceutical products) and HS 2941 (antibiotics), exports and imports with the world, 2024 and 2025
comtrade.notes: Values in current US dollars as reported by each country (exports free on board, imports as reported). Downloaded from the public preview API on the date shown; 2025 figures cover fewer countries because many had not yet reported. UN Comtrade data is not openly licensed: redistribution is restricted under its usage policy, which exempts small numbers of records and free public visualisation. Ask comtrade@un.org before reusing these figures in bulk.

ema-shortages.title: Medicine shortages catalogue (download of all shortages)
ema-shortages.notes: Shortages that EMA assesses: mostly centrally authorised medicines or shortages affecting several EU countries. National shortages are listed by each country's regulator instead. File generated 6 November 2026, 18:00. EMA content may be reproduced with acknowledgement of the source.

ema-ulcm.publisher: European Medicines Agency, Heads of Medicines Agencies and European Commission
ema-ulcm.title: Union list of critical medicines, version 2.1 (revision 2), EMA/229885/2026
ema-ulcm.notes: Active substances, by ATC code, whose supply the EU treats as critical. Grouped here by the first letter of the ATC code (the anatomical main group), using the group names given in the file. Reproduction authorised with acknowledgement.

cpe-pc.title: Price concessions and price concession archive
cpe-pc.notes: Each line is a generic medicine and pack size for which DHSC granted a price above the Drug Tariff because pharmacies in England could not buy it at the Tariff price. Counted here from the monthly lists in the archive, one per distinct product and pack size; the counts match the monthly totals CPE publishes in its updates. © Community Pharmacy England; the lists record DHSC decisions.

nhsbsa-ssp.title: Serious Shortage Protocols (SSPs)
nhsbsa-ssp.notes: Protocols issued by DHSC that let pharmacists in the UK supply an alternative to a prescribed medicine in serious shortage. Active list as read on the date shown. Open Government Licence v3.0.
